title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
summary: ATV Big Air Tour 利用 ChatGPT Work 将原本需要 3 天的工作缩短至 3 小时，并快速完成营销、商品化及库存网站搭建。
highlights: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more.
It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.
